scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained for arbitrary finite fields. Finite-field brute-force and sampled computations corroborate but do not establish the general formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary linear automorphisms of the standard graded filiform Lie algebra in dimensions at least four; it does not count conjugacy classes or extend to all filiform algebras. A possible stronger general almost-abelian counting theorem remains a historical priority risk. Complete text of one relevant 2016 finite-field classification paper could not be inspected. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: An arithmetic phase transition for fixed-point-free automorphisms of standard filiform Lie algebras
